Add olive oil and continue mixing. Finish by hand, kneading until smooth and elastic.
Shape into a disk, wrap in plastic, rest at least an hour.
Roll out by hand or pasta machine to desired thickness.
recipes.notes: Adapted from The Art of Simple Food.

recipes.name: Ricotta Ravioli with Wild Mushroom Sauce

ingredients.name: Green garlic stalk or 2 garlic cloves

instructions: Combine ricotta, green garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Roll out pasta thin, cut into 14-inch sheets.
Pipe or spoon 1 tablespoon of filling along lower third of a sheet, 1.5 inches between blobs.
Mist with water. Fold upper half over lower. Press out air and seal.
Cut between portions. Separate onto floured sheet pan.
Cover and refrigerate.
For sauce: clean mushrooms, tear into quarters.
Make mushroom broth: simmer trimmings with onion, bay, thyme in water 10 minutes. Strain.
Sauté mushrooms with butter over low heat until golden. Season.
Add broth or stock, simmer briefly. Swirl in cold butter. Taste.
Cook ravioli in salted simmering water 5-6 minutes. Drain and add to sauce.
Serve with gremolata and Parmesan.
recipes.notes: Adapted from The Art of Simple Food.

recipes.name: Roasted Almonds with Rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Mix nuts and rosemary. Add oil and salt, toss to coat.
Spread on baking sheet and bake 20 minutes.
Stir and return for 10 more minutes. Check; about 35 minutes total.
recipes.notes: Adapted from My Pantry.

recipes.name: Sautéed Olives
instructions: Take olives out of brine and rinse.
Put olives into a sauté pan and toss with lemon zest, fennel seeds, bay leaves, and olive oil.
Add a little water and warm gently over low heat for 3 minutes.
Spoon into a bowl.
recipes.notes: Adapted from Fanny in France.

recipes.name: Aïoli (Garlic Mayonnaise)
instructions: Pound garlic with salt in a mortar to a very smooth purée. Reserve half.
Separate egg yolk into a mixing bowl, add about half the garlic and water. Mix with a whisk.
Slowly dribble oil into yolk mixture, whisking constantly.
As yolk absorbs oil, sauce thickens. Then add oil a little faster, whisking.
Thin with a few drops of water if too thick. Taste and adjust.
recipes.notes: Adapted from The Art of Simple Food. Makes 1 cup.

recipes.name: Pear Compote with Crab Apple Jelly
instructions: Put jelly into a small saucepan and gently warm to melt.
Remove from heat and squeeze in juice of orange. Whisk together.
Peel and slice pears, put into a bowl with raspberries.
Pour jelly sauce over fruit and gently mix.
Let soak 30 minutes. Chill and let macerate until ready to serve.
recipes.notes: Any jam can be used.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken (Alice Waters)
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and thyme. Drizzle with olive oil. Pull from fridge 1 hour before cooking.
Prepare bed of coals; let them burn to medium-hot. Clean grate and set 5-6 inches above coals.
Place chicken skin side down. Cook 7 minutes until skin is brown and crispy.
Turn and cook 3-5 minutes more. Check doneness.
Rest 5 minutes before cutting.
recipes.notes: Adapted from The Art of Simple Food.

recipes.name: Chicken Cooked Under a Brick
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme. Drizzle with olive oil.
Heat cast-iron skillet over medium heat. Add oil, then place chicken skin side down.
Wrap another skillet in foil to use as a weight. Place on top of the chicken.
Cook at medium 10 to 12 minutes.
Remove weight, flip chicken. Pour off rendered fat. Cook a few more minutes.
recipes.notes: Adapted from The Art of Simple Food. Classic pollo al mattone.

recipes.name: Crispy Fingerling Potatoes
instructions: Start potatoes in cold, salted water.
Boil until tender; test with a knife.
Cut parboiled fingerlings in half lengthwise. Drizzle with olive oil and salt.
Finish on hot grill flat side down to brown, or in a hot pan 5 minutes after removing chicken.
recipes.notes: Parboil ahead.

recipes.name: Alice's Egg in a Spoon

ingredients.name: Piece toast, grilled and rubbed with garlic

instructions: Build a fire with heat from top and bottom. Let logs cook down about 40 minutes.
Crack egg into a bowl without breaking the yolk. Season with salt and marash pepper.
Coat a long fireplace spoon with olive oil. Pour egg into spoon and lift into the fire.
Whites will puff up. Pull off any ash.
Egg is ready when top browns. Slide onto toast.
Top with more marash pepper. Serve with a green salad.
recipes.notes: Cooked in a fireplace on a long spoon.

recipes.name: Sautéed Chicken Paillard with Sauce Vierge
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast, about 5 ounces

instructions: Lay the chicken breast on plastic wrap and fold the wrap over the meat. Pound to even thickness using the smooth side of a meat mallet.
Season both sides with salt. Pour canola oil into a sauté pan to about 1/8-inch deep and heat over high heat.

When the oil is shimmering, lay the chicken into the pan working away from you. Shake to prevent sticking. Reduce heat to medium-high and cook about 3 minutes per side until the underside is browned and the chicken is just cooked through (spoon hot oil over to speed cooking).
Pickled red onions: combine 2 parts water, 1 part sugar, 1 part vinegar in a saucepot, simmer until sugar dissolves, then pour over sliced red onions in a canning jar. Refrigerate.
Arugula salad: dress arugula lightly with olive oil and salt, toss. Garnish with marcona almonds, pickled red onions, and a splash of balsamic vinegar.
Sauce vierge: combine diced tomatoes and minced shallot in a bowl with olive oil to coat. Add Maldon salt, a drop of balsamic, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix gently.
Plate the chicken paillard topped with arugula salad and sauce vierge.
recipes.notes: Paillard is a French boneless-meat cutlet pounded thin. Chef Keller cooks with canola oil for its high smoke point and finishes with olive oil. Sauce vierge can also dress fish, eggs, or zucchini.

recipes.name: Ad Hoc Buttermilk Fried Chicken
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: Fleur de sel or fine sea salt

instructions: Combine all brine ingredients with 1 gallon of water, bring to a boil, cool, then refrigerate until chilled.
Cut chicken into 10 pieces (2 wings, 2 legs, 2 thighs, 2 breast halves each). Submerge in cold brine for 12 hours (8 hour minimum, do not exceed 12 hours).
Remove chicken from brine, rinse, pat dry, and let come to room temperature.
Combine flour, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, and pepper for the seasoned flour.
Set up dredging: seasoned flour in one bowl, buttermilk (seasoned with salt and pepper) in another.
Heat 2 inches of peanut oil to 325°F in a cast-iron skillet. Dredge each piece in flour, then buttermilk, then flour again.
Fry dark meat first for 2 minutes, then add white meat after 4 minutes. Fry about 11 minutes total, maintaining 325°F, until internal temp is 160–165°F and crust is golden brown.
Drain on a rack; fry rosemary sprigs in the oil until they stop sizzling. Sprinkle chicken with ground kosher salt and garnish with fried rosemary.

Braised greens: trim and clean swiss chard and collard greens. Sweat 500 g yellow onion and 300 g bacon lardons in canola oil with kosher salt. Add minced garlic, then 100 g sugar and 200 g apple cider vinegar; reduce to syrup. Add greens with 500 g chicken stock and braise 2 hours, adding stock as needed; fold in halved cherry tomatoes.

Mashed potatoes: simmer 750 g whole unpeeled Yukon Gold potatoes in cold water until tender. Press through a ricer into a saucepan; over medium-low heat work in 190 g hot cream, 225 g cold butter cubes, and 50 g clarified butter to taste.
recipes.notes: Served every other Monday at Ad Hoc in Yountville. Includes accompaniments: braised greens (swiss chard + collards) and mashed potatoes.

recipes.name: Pan-Roasted Duck Breast with Honey-Orange Gastrique and Braised Endive
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II
instructions: Pat duck breast dry and air-dry skin-side up uncovered in the refrigerator for 3 days.
Trim silver skin and prick the skin all over with a sausage pricker.
Heat a thin layer of canola oil in a sauté pan over medium heat. Lay duck skin-side down. Cook slowly, pressing to keep skin in contact, basting once 80% done. Cook to internal 123°F for medium rare.
When the duck is 90% done, pour off excess fat, add the endive cut-side down to the pan, flip duck to color the meat side briefly, then rest on a rack 5 min.

Honey-orange gastrique: simmer 50 g honey and 150 g orange juice until syrupy and lightly caramelized. Add veal stock; reduce by a third. Add orange zest, adjust with lemon juice, season with salt, and finish off-heat with cold butter.

Braised endive: trim endives to even diameter, remove core, salt inside and out, rest 30 min, then rinse. Brown lightly in 1/4 inch canola oil, then add orange juice to cover. Cover with a parchment cartouche and simmer 30–40 min until tender. Caramelize in the duck pan to serve.
Slice the duck and fan on the plate; place endive alongside; spoon gastrique around.
recipes.notes: Pekin/Long Island duck is mild and pan-roasts beautifully. The 3-day air-dry is essential for crispy skin.

recipes.name: Pan-Roasted Côte de Bœuf with Maître d'Hôtel Butter
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 100 g unsalted butter, room temp (for maître d'hôtel)

instructions: Truss the rib steak with kitchen twine to hold shape. Salt both sides generously and air-dry uncovered in the refrigerator overnight.
1 hour before cooking, remove meat from the fridge to temper. Pat dry if needed. Heat oven to 450°F and a cast-iron skillet over high heat.
Wrap the bone in foil, re-season with salt, and add 3/8 inch canola oil to the hot skillet. Sear meat 4–5 min until dark brown, flip and sear 2–3 min more.
Pour off most of the oil, add a tablespoon of fresh oil, then cold cubed butter, thyme, and crushed garlic. Baste a few minutes, then transfer to the oven.
After 5 min, baste again on the stovetop for 1 min. Return to the oven 10–15 min until internal temp is 130°F (medium-rare). Rest 10–15 min.
Maître d'hôtel butter: stir together 100 g room-temp butter, parsley, lemon juice, and salt. Roll in plastic into a log, chill, then slice into discs.
Blanched asparagus: trim asparagus, bundle and tie. Boil in heavily salted water (as salty as seawater) until tender, about 2 1/2 min. Drain.
Slice steak against the grain into 1/4-inch slices, finish with sel gris, and place 3 discs of maître d'hôtel butter on top (gently melt with kitchen torch). Serve with asparagus.
recipes.notes: Côte de bœuf is a celebration dish for two. Ask your butcher for a double-cut rib steak with the bone Frenched.

recipes.name: Brined and Air-Dried Oven-Roasted Chicken
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II
instructions: Mix all brine ingredients with 1 gallon water; bring to a boil, cool, and chill.
Remove neck and innards; cut out the wishbone. Submerge chicken in cold brine for 8–12 hours.
Truss the chicken and air-dry, uncovered, in the refrigerator for 2 days.
Bring chicken to room temperature (1 1/2 to 2 hours). Preheat oven to 475°F.

Prepare root vegetables: cut rutabagas, turnips, parsnips, leeks (cleaned and halved), carrots, and onion into similarly sized wedges; leave potatoes whole. Toss in a roasting pan with salt and clarified butter or canola oil.
Brush chicken with clarified butter, salt all over, and nestle into the bed of vegetables.
Roast 20–25 min at 475°F. Reduce to 400°F and roast 30–45 min more, until the thigh reads 160°F. Rest 20–30 min.
Reheat vegetables in pan juices on the stovetop, finish with a squeeze of lemon. Carve chicken, arrange over vegetables, and finish with grey sea salt.
recipes.notes: Chef Keller's go-to last-meal contender; a Bouchon signature. The two-day air-dry after trussing is what gives the skin its crackle.

recipes.name: Blowtorch Slow-Roasted Prime Rib with Horseradish Cream
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 1 two-bone center-cut rib roast, about 4 1/2 lbs
454 g (1 lb) sweet garden carrots, peeled, oblique cut

instructions: Truss the rib roast and place on a rack over a roasting pan. Score the fat at 1/16 inch intervals (optional). Salt all sides and air-dry uncovered overnight.
Preheat oven to 275°F. Hold a propane blowtorch about an inch from the roast and lightly brown all white fat and red surfaces.
Season generously with salt and roast about 2 hours, until the center registers 128°F.
Rest at least 30 min — carryover will bring the internal temp to 132°F for medium-rare.
Horseradish cream: whip crème fraîche and prepared horseradish to soft peaks (work over ice). Top with sliced chives.

Glazed carrots: arrange carrots in a single layer in a saucepan. Add sugar, butter, and water to barely cover. Boil over high heat, swirling, until water evaporates and a glaze forms. Toss with chopped parsley and a flake of finishing salt.

Potato purée: simmer whole unpeeled Yukon Gold potatoes in cold water until tender. Pass through a fine tamis. Over medium-low heat, work in hot cream, cold butter cubes, and clarified butter to a creamy purée. Season with salt.
Carve roast into 1/2-inch slices, finish with sel gris and pepper, and serve with horseradish cream, glazed carrots, and potato purée.
recipes.notes: Slow roasting at 275°F after blowtorching yields edge-to-edge medium-rare. A propane torch works better than a small butane kitchen torch.

recipes.name: Pork Shoulder à la Matignon with Potato Rösti
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 375 g Granny Smith apples, cored and diced

instructions: Make the sachet: wrap bay leaf, cinnamon stick, star anise, and cloves in cheesecloth and tie.
Bring pork shoulder to room temperature. Tie with kitchen twine to hold its plump shape; season with kosher salt.
Preheat oven to 275°F. Heat 1/4 inch of canola oil in a large cocotte over medium-high. Sear pork on all sides until well-browned, then transfer to a rack.
In the rendered fat, sauté onions with salt until caramelized. Add apples and celery root.

Add sachet and most of the cider (reserve some for the slurry). Stir in honey. Nestle pork back in, cover, and transfer to the oven for about 4 hours, checking after 2 1/2. Cooked when a cake tester slides through with no resistance.

Make potato rösti: peel potatoes and julienne lengthwise on mandoline. Toss with 10 g salt and rest 5 min; squeeze dry in a lint-free towel. Toss with 2 tbsp clarified butter. Heat an 8-inch sauté pan with 3 tbsp clarified butter and compact potatoes into an even 1-inch layer. Cook until golden, flip, add remaining butter around the edges, and continue 10–15 min until well-browned. Sprinkle with chives and cut into wedges.

Remove pork and sachet, rest on a rack. Bring liquid to a simmer. Grind kuzu in a mortar; whisk with reserved cider into a slurry. Stir in a third of the slurry, add more for desired thickness. Taste and adjust salt; add Calvados and finish with vinegar if needed.
Slice pork. Ladle matignon vegetables onto the plate, top with pork, garnish with watercress, and serve with rösti.
recipes.notes: Substitute apple juice (and omit honey) for an alcohol-free version. Bouquet garni is parsley/thyme/bay; a sachet can hold any aromatics — Chef Keller uses cheesecloth for easy removal.

recipes.name: Pressure Cooker Roasted Veal Stock
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 3.2 kg veal osso buco or meaty neck bones

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (convection if available). Dry the bones, cut meat from them, and slice the meat into 1/2-inch pieces. Toss bones and meat in canola oil and arrange in a roasting pan.
Roast about 45 min, stirring once, until deeply mahogany.
Meanwhile, heat the pressure cooker over medium-high. Halve one onion and char it cut-side down in 3 tbsp oil about 10 min until blackened. Remove.
Reduce heat; add diced tomatoes and caramelize. Deglaze with a little water and re-caramelize.
Add the roasted bones. Deglaze the roasting pan with 1/2 liter water, scraping fond, and pour into the pressure cooker.
Add the brûléed onion, sliced onions, carrots, garlic, thyme, bay, calf's foot, and 3 1/2 liters hot water — submerge everything. Seal and bring to 15 PSI.
Hold at 15 PSI for 90 min. Allow pressure to release naturally.
Scoop out bones and vegetables. Strain through a coarse strainer, then a chinois into a clean container. Cool, refrigerate overnight, then skim solidified fat.
Use immediately or freeze for up to a month.
recipes.notes: Yields about 4 liters. Pressure cooking steams rather than simmers, so there's little to skim during cooking. Stovetop version takes ~8 hours uncovered.

recipes.name: Emulsified Egg-Yolk Vinaigrette
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II
instructions: Combine egg yolk, mustard, shallots, garlic, and thyme leaves in a mixing bowl.
Drizzle olive oil in slowly while whisking constantly until emulsified.
Stream in balsamic vinegar while whisking; taste and adjust.
Store sealed in the refrigerator up to a week.
recipes.notes: Mustard alone can serve as the binding agent if you'd rather skip the raw yolk.

recipes.name: Sauce Vierge
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 125 g tomatoes, peeled, cored, and diced
15 g vinegar of your choice (balsamic or champagne)

instructions: Combine diced tomatoes and minced shallots in a bowl.
Add enough olive oil to coat and absorb into the tomatoes.
Fold in chopped parsley; season with Maldon salt, vinegar, and fresh lemon juice.
recipes.notes: Michel Guérard's classic cuisine minceur sauce. Pairs with fish, eggs, chicken, or vegetables.

recipes.name: Pickled Chow Chow Vinaigrette
recipes.source: Thomas Keller MasterClass — Cooking Techniques II

ingredients.name: 35 g jingle bell peppers (or other small variety)
Juice from half a lemon (~20 g)

instructions: Pickle the vegetables: combine water, vinegar, sugar, thyme, mustard seeds, and garlic in a saucepot and bring to a simmer. Pack cauliflower, pearl onions, cucumbers, radishes, and small peppers into a canning jar. Pour the hot pickling liquid over to submerge, seal, and refrigerate.
Chop pickled vegetables and combine with mustard, olive oil, shallot, and reserved pickling liquid. Add a squeeze of lemon and salt to taste. Garnish with chives.
recipes.notes: Cut vegetables to uniform size for even pickling. Great with poultry, fish, or eggs.

recipes.name: Garam Masala

ingredients.name: cinnamon sticks (2 inches each), broken into pieces

instructions: Combine all of the spices in a clean coffee grinder or spice grinder.
Pulse first, then grind until you have a fine powder.
Transfer the powder to an airtight container. Store in a cool, dark place.
recipes.notes: Makes about 1/4 cup. Madhur's six-spice blend: cardamom, cloves, black peppercorns, cumin, nutmeg, and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Roasted Cumin Powder
instructions: Warm a small cast-iron skillet over medium-low heat.
When hot, add cumin seeds and roast, stirring continuously, until seeds are a shade darker and just beginning to smoke, 2 to 3 minutes.
Remove pan from heat and quickly transfer seeds to a bowl or paper towel-lined plate to cool.
Grind seeds to a fine powder in a clean coffee or spice grinder.
Store in an airtight container for up to 2 months.
recipes.notes: Makes about 2 tablespoons. Used as a garnish over raita or vegetables in North India.

recipes.name: Potato a Thousand Ways

ingredients.name: large waxy potatoes (red or Yukon Gold)

instructions: Boil potatoes whole until easily pierced, 15-20 minutes. Drain, cool, peel and dice into 1/2-inch chunks (or mash coarsely for Dosa).
Cumin version: Heat oil over medium-high; sizzle cumin seeds 30 seconds. Add potatoes, season with salt; stir-fry until golden, 5-7 minutes.
Southern version: Pop mustard seeds in oil; add broken red chilies, toast 1 minute, add curry leaves. Add potatoes and water, season with salt; cook covered until water evaporates, 5-7 minutes.
Northern version: Pop cumin and black mustard seeds in oil; add sesame seeds. Add potatoes, stir-fry until golden; add cayenne. Season with salt and lemon juice.

Dosa version: Toast chana then urad dal in oil; add black mustard seeds. Once popping, add curry leaves, then onion, ginger, green chilies. Stir 2-3 min, splash of water. Cover, cook until onions soft. Add potatoes, stir 2-3 min adding water for loose consistency. Stir in turmeric and salt; finish with cilantro.
recipes.notes: Four regional variations from a single base. Each serves 2.

recipes.name: Cherry Tomato and Cucumber Salad

ingredients.name: medium cucumbers (Kirby) or 1 large English cucumber
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Peel cucumbers; cut into quarters lengthwise then crosswise. Arrange on a plate with tomatoes.
Drizzle with lemon juice; season with salt, pepper, cayenne. Sprinkle roasted cumin over top.
Heat oil over medium-high; add mustard seeds. When sputtering stops, add curry leaves until glossy (a few seconds); pour the tadka over the salad and serve.
recipes.notes: A tadka-finished salad. Mustard seeds reach optimum flavor when sputtering stops.

recipes.name: Goan Shrimp

ingredients.name: paprika or Kashmiri red chili powder
large or medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

instructions: Warm oil in a medium saute pan over medium heat. Add shallots; fry until golden brown and crispy, a few minutes.
Remove pan from heat; add cayenne, paprika, black pepper, and turmeric. Stir into a smooth paste.
Shake coconut milk vigorously; return pan to heat and add 1 1/4 cups milk. Bring to a rolling simmer, scraping up bits.
Reduce heat to low; add shrimp. Season with salt and lemon juice. Cook until shrimp are pink and opaque. Serve with rice.
recipes.notes: Spicy coconut shrimp curry from Goa.

recipes.name: Kerala-Style Fish

ingredients.name: skin-on wild sea bass fillet, 1/2- to 3/4-in thick, cut into 3-in slices
basmati or jasmine rice, for serving

instructions: Season fish with salt, set aside.
Heat oil in a frying pan over medium-high; saute shallots until edges brown.
Add ginger and garlic; stir-fry until fragrant, 1 minute. Add water, turmeric, cayenne, paprika, lemon juice; season with salt and pepper. Bring to simmer.
Reduce heat to low; simmer 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup coconut milk.
Return sauce to simmer; arrange fish in even layer. Cook 5-6 minutes, bathing fish with sauce. Serve with rice.
recipes.notes: One-pot meen moilee. Substitute haddock, halibut, salmon, or kingfish.

recipes.name: South Indian Mixed Vegetable Kurma

ingredients.name: medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped (canned is fine)
carrots, peeled and cut into 1/2-in rounds
small head cauliflower, cut into 3/4-in florets
green beans, trimmed and cut into 3/4-in pieces
basmati rice or rice noodles, for serving

instructions: Cover cashews with hot water; after 1 hour, drain and transfer to blender.
Add tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt, green chilies, and garam masala; blend smooth. Add cilantro; pulse. Reserve.
Warm oil in a saucepan over medium-high. Add mustard seeds and urad dal. When sputtering, add red chili; swirl, then add curry leaves.
Add carrots, peas, cauliflower, green beans. Reduce to medium, season with remaining salt; saute 5 minutes. Add 1/2 cup water; simmer, cover; cook 3-4 minutes.
Add cashew-tomato mixture; bring to boil. Cover, lower heat. Cook 3-5 minutes until tender.
Stir in 1/2 cup coconut milk; cook 1 minute. Serve over rice or rice noodles.
recipes.notes: Cashew-based curry from Tamil Nadu. Cashews soak 1 hour.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken

ingredients.name: fresh hot green chili (bird's eye), finely chopped
cayenne pepper or red chili powder

instructions: Combine tomato paste and water in a measuring cup. Whisk; add ginger, cream, garam masala, salt, sugar, green chili, cayenne, cilantro, lemon juice, and cumin. Stir.
Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add tomato-cream mixture; simmer, stirring.
Add chicken; turn often to coat. Transfer to a warm platter and spoon sauce over top.
recipes.notes: North Indian dish where chicken is roasted tandoori-style first, then simmered in butter-cream-tomato sauce. Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.name: Aloo Gosht (Pakistani Potato and Goat)

ingredients.name: olive oil, canola oil, or ghee
cinnamon stick (4 inches), broken into pieces
large red onion, halved and thinly sliced
goat meat, mix of bone-in and boneless, cut into 1 1/2-in pieces

instructions: Heat oil/ghee in heavy pot over medium-high. Add cinnamon, cardamom, onion; saute until onions are light brown at edges, 5-7 minutes. Add garlic and ginger.
After 1 minute, add goat, turmeric, coriander, cayenne. Stir; add 1 cup water. Boil, reduce to medium, cover. Cook 10 minutes until liquid evaporated. Uncover, cook 3-4 minutes to brown.
Add remaining 4 cups water; boil. Reduce to low, cover, cook 1 hour.
Add potatoes; season with salt. Boil, reduce to low, cover. Cook 30 minutes until meat is fall-apart tender.
Stir in garam masala; serve.
recipes.notes: Madhur recommends a marrow bone. Lamb shoulder substitutes for goat. Serve with chapati and dal, or rice.

recipes.name: Lemony Chicken With Coriander (Cilantro)

ingredients.name: knob fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped
fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye), finely chopped

instructions: Combine 4 tbsp water with ginger in food processor; pulse to paste.
Heat oil in a lidded saute pan over medium-high. Brown chicken in batches; transfer to bowl.
Fry garlic until browning. Add ginger paste, stir-fry 1 minute. Add cilantro, green chili, cayenne, cumin, coriander, turmeric. Season with salt; cook 1 minute.
Return chicken and juices; add remaining water and lemon juice. Boil, reduce to low, cover.
Cook 15 minutes; flip pieces. Cover, cook 10-15 minutes until chicken is done.
recipes.notes: Bright chicken curry with cilantro and ginger. Serve with basmati rice.

recipes.name: Baked Lamb Shami Kebabs

ingredients.name: medium onions: 1 thinly sliced, 1 finely chopped
fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye), finely chopped
fresh mint leaves, chopped, plus sprigs for garnish

instructions: Submerge onion rings in ice water; refrigerate 1-5 hours.
Combine chopped onion, chilies, mint, lemon juice; season with salt. Rest 20 minutes.
Toast almonds 3-4 minutes; cool. Toast poppy seeds 1-2 minutes; cool.
Grind almonds, then poppy seeds to fine powder. Combine with lamb, cumin, garam masala, cayenne, yogurt, 1 tsp salt, and onion-mint mixture. Knead into a ball.
Preheat 350F. Butter 8x8 baking dish. Press meat into even layer.
Bake 50 minutes. Drain liquid; broil 1 minute.
Drain pickled onions; dry on towel.
Slice patty into 1-inch squares; arrange with chilled onions and mint sprigs.
recipes.notes: Sheet-pan kebabs spiced with cumin, garam masala, cayenne.

recipes.name: Cauliflower and Potatoes With Cumin and Asafetida

ingredients.name: medium head cauliflower, broken into florets

instructions: Boil potato whole until pierced, 10 minutes. Cool, peel, dice into 1-inch cubes.
Combine cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, and salt.
Warm oil in pan/wok over medium. Add asafetida then cumin seeds. When sizzling, add cauliflower and potato; saute 6-8 minutes until golden.
Add spice mixture; toss. Add water; cover, reduce to low. Cook 5-7 minutes until cauliflower is tender.
recipes.notes: Punjabi aloo gobi. Cut cauliflower to match potato size for even cooking.

recipes.name: Okra With Shallots

ingredients.name: fresh okra pods, stems and tips removed

instructions: Slice okra on bias into 3-4 pieces.
Warm oil in pan over medium-high. Add cumin seeds; sizzle. Add okra; saute 5 minutes.
Add shallots; fry 3 minutes.
Reduce heat; add coriander, red pepper flakes, salt. Stir-fry 7-9 minutes. Add lemon juice.
recipes.notes: Keep okra dry before cooking to avoid sliminess.

recipes.name: Eggplant Bharta

ingredients.name: fresh hot green chili, finely chopped (optional)
roughly chopped cilantro, plus more for garnish

instructions: Roast eggplant: broil until evenly charred, OR char on gas burner 25-40 minutes.
Run cool water over eggplant; remove charred skin. Coarsely chop flesh.
Blend onion, ginger, garlic, 3 tbsp water into paste. Chop 2 canned tomatoes; reserve.
Warm oil in skillet over medium. Add paste and turmeric; stir-fry 5 minutes. Add green chili and cilantro; cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes.
Reduce to low; cook 10 minutes. Add eggplant; cook 10-15 minutes. Season with salt, lemon juice, garam masala.
Garnish with cilantro.
recipes.notes: Traditional smoky eggplant with onion, ginger, and tomato.

recipes.name: Plain Basmati Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 325F.
Cover rice with cold water; agitate, drain. Rinse 3-4 more times. Soak 30 minutes.
Drain; add to heavy ovenproof pot. Add 1 1/3 cups water; bring to boil over medium.
Cover with foil and lid; bake 30 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; fluff and serve.
recipes.notes: Oven-steamed method ensures separate grains.

recipes.name: Lamb Biryani

ingredients.name: knob fresh ginger, peeled and chopped
boneless lamb shoulder, diced into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Rinse rice; soak in 7 cups water with 1 tbsp salt for 3 hours.
Toast saffron in dry pan; crumble into warm milk. Steep 3 hours.
Slice 2 onions; reserve. Blend remaining onion with garlic, ginger, 2 tbsp almonds, 3 tbsp water into thick paste.
Fry sliced onions in 6 tbsp oil until golden and crispy; drain. Fry raisins until plump; drain. Fry remaining almonds; drain.
Brown lamb in batches; reserve.
Add 7 more tbsp oil. Fry garlic-ginger paste until medium brown, splashing water as needed.
Return lamb; stir in yogurt 1 tbsp at a time. Season with 1 1/4 tsp salt; add 1/2 cup water. Simmer covered on low 30 minutes.
Grind cloves, peppercorns, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, nutmeg.
Add spice blend and cayenne to lamb; cover, cook 30 minutes.
Increase to medium; cook until juices reduce to about 1 cup. Transfer meat to lidded casserole; cover.
Preheat 300F. Boil 12 cups salted water. Drain soaked rice; cook 6 minutes at rapid boil; drain.
Pile rice over meat in hill shape; chopstick a 1-inch opening down center. Drizzle saffron milk; rest butter pieces around. Sprinkle with 2 tbsp fried onions.
Cover tightly; bake 1 hour.
Gently fold rice and meat together; transfer to platter. Garnish with eggs, raisins, almonds, remaining onions.
recipes.notes: Madhur's celebration biryani. 3-hour soaks essential.

recipes.name: Chapatis

ingredients.name: ata (Indian whole wheat flour), plus extra for dusting

instructions: Combine flour and water; knead 10-15 minutes into soft dough.
Cover with damp towel; rest 3 hours.
Knead again. Divide into 6 pieces; ball and flatten. Cover.
Warm cast-iron skillet over medium.
Roll a chapati to 6-inch round; slap onto skillet. Cook 20-30 seconds.
Flip; cook 20-30 seconds. Flip; press with dry towel, rotating, until chapati puffs.
Transfer to towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining dough.
recipes.notes: Chapati means 'to slap.' Make right before serving.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Cheela (Pancake)

ingredients.name: fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye), finely chopped
large shallots: 1 finely chopped, 1 sliced into rings
olive or peanut oil for frying
chutneys, pickles, yogurt relishes for serving

instructions: Soak moong dal in cool water 5-6 hours. Drain.
Blend with ginger, garlic, turmeric, salt, 3/4 cup water until fine. Add chilies and cilantro; pulse. Stir in chopped shallots and 3 tbsp water.
Warm 1 tsp oil in nonstick pan over medium-low. Spoon 1/3 cup batter; spread with measuring cup base to 5 inches. Brush wet batter from center toward edges.
When 7-8 inches across, spread 1 tbsp each sliced shallots and red peppers, pressing in. Drizzle oil around rim. Sprinkle salt, pepper, chili powder. Cover; cook 2 minutes.
Flip; cook 1 more minute.
Serve with chutneys, pickles, relishes.
recipes.notes: Flourless gluten-free pancakes from North India.

recipes.name: Plain Square Paratha

ingredients.name: ata (Indian whole wheat flour), plus more for dusting
peanut or vegetable oil, plus 5-6 tbsp (or ghee)

instructions: Combine ata and salt; stir in 1 tsp oil. Add lukewarm water, knead to soft dough. Knead 10 minutes; coat with oil, cover, rest 30-60 min.
Divide dough into 6 portions; ball them. Cover.
Warm cast-iron skillet over medium until smoking; remove.
Roll a ball to 6-inch round. Brush with oil/ghee; fold upper third to center, brush; fold lower third, brush. Fold each end to center to make a square; brush folds.
Press flat; roll into 6-inch square.
Heat pan, slap paratha onto skillet.
Cook 1 minute. Flip; brush with oil. Cook 1 minute; flip and brush.
Turn 4 final times waiting 3-4 seconds between, until golden.
Repeat with remaining dough.
recipes.notes: Flaky pastry-like flatbread with oil/ghee folded between layers.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha

ingredients.name: ata (Indian whole wheat flour), plus more for dusting
cayenne pepper or red chili powder
fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye), finely chopped

instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain, cool, refrigerate to dry.
Mix ata and salt; stir in 1 tsp oil. Add water, knead to dough. Knead 10 minutes; coat with oil, cover, rest 30-60 min.
Divide dough into 6 balls. Cover.
Peel potatoes; break into small pieces. Mix with cayenne, garam masala, coriander seeds, amchoor, chilies, cilantro.
Heat skillet over medium until smoking; remove.
Season potatoes with 1 tsp salt; divide into 6 balls.
Roll dough ball to 5 1/2-6 inch round; brush with oil. Place potato ball in center; pinch closed and twist top. Flatten with palm.
Roll out to 7-7 1/2 inches, flipping and dusting.
Slap onto skillet. Cook 1 minute. Flip, brush with oil. Cook 1 minute, flip and brush.
Turn 4 final times. Remove to towel-lined plate.
Repeat with remaining dough.
recipes.notes: Stuffed potato paratha for North Indian breakfast. Dry potatoes thoroughly.

recipes.name: Besan Cheela (Chickpea Pancake)

ingredients.name: large tomato, peeled, seeded, finely chopped
fresh hot green chili (bird's eye), finely chopped

instructions: Sift chickpea flour, salt, cumin, turmeric, garam masala, asafetida. Stir in water to a thin pourable batter.
Add tomato, shallot, green chili. Rest 2 hours.
Heat 1/2 tsp oil in 6-inch nonstick pan over medium. Stir batter; ladle ~1/4 cup. Tilt to spread to edges. Cook 2 minutes.
Flip; cook 2 minutes pressing gently.
Repeat with remaining batter.
recipes.notes: Indian chickpea omelet pancakes.

recipes.name: Moong Dal and Red Lentils With Browned Onions

ingredients.name: small onion, sliced into thin half-rings

instructions: Combine dals; rinse until water runs clear.
Transfer to lidded pot with 6 1/2 cups water; simmer over medium. Skim froth. Add turmeric. Cover partially, reduce to low.
Cook 40-50 minutes until tender. Season with salt.
For tadka: heat oil/ghee in skillet over high. Add asafetida and cumin seeds. When sizzling, add red chilies. Add onion; fry until reddish brown and crispy.
Pour hot tadka over dal; cover immediately.
recipes.notes: Two-dal blend with classic asafetida-cumin-chili tadka.

recipes.name: Chickpeas in Simple Northern-Style

ingredients.name: fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye), finely chopped
15-oz cans organic chickpeas, drained, liquid reserved

instructions: Heat oil over medium. Add onions; saute 7-8 minutes until browning. Add ginger, garlic, chilies; fry until onions golden.
Add coriander, cumin, turmeric. Add tomato paste.
Add chickpeas, 2 1/4 cups soaking liquid or water, salt. Simmer covered on low 30 minutes.
recipes.notes: Punjabi chole. Traditionally served with bhatura or naan.

recipes.name: Green Chutney
instructions: Blend lemon juice, tomato, mint, cilantro, chilies, sugar to smooth paste.
Add salt; pulse. Store in airtight container in refrigerator.
recipes.notes: Pairs with kebabs, chaat, and more.

recipes.name: Tamarind Chutney
instructions: Break off ~1/3 cup tamarind into smaller pieces.
Cover with hot water; soak overnight. Mash with fingers.
Strain pulp through coarse mesh strainer.
Add sugar, salt, cumin, cayenne, ginger, mint. Stir to heavy pourable cream consistency.
Refrigerate up to 7 days or freeze.
recipes.notes: Sweet-sour-spicy condiment from tamarind brick.

recipes.name: Punjabi-Style Sweet-and-Sour Mixed Vegetable Pickle

ingredients.name: carrot, peeled and cut into matchsticks
head of cauliflower, cut into florets
whole brown or yellow mustard seeds

instructions: Boil water in large pot. Add carrots, turnips, cauliflower; return to boil. Drain. Cool.
Warm mustard oil in skillet over medium until smoky. Cool to room temp.
Combine brown sugar and vinegar; stir to dissolve. Grind mustard seeds; add with garlic, ginger, cayenne, salt.
Add vegetables; toss to coat. Transfer to a glass jar. Top with mustard oil; seal and shake.
Place in sunny spot 10-15 days, shaking daily.
Refrigerate between uses.
recipes.notes: Makes 1 1/2 quarts. Sun-cured Punjabi pickle.

recipes.name: Pickled Green Chilies

ingredients.name: fresh hot green chilies (bird's eye, Thai, or serrano)
fresh ginger, peeled and finely chopped

instructions: Wipe chilies clean. Arrange in single layer in sunny spot to dry.
Wearing gloves, slice off stems and finely slice chilies.
Grind mustard seeds. Add to chilies with salt, cayenne, ginger.
Warm mustard oil until smoking; cool to room temp. Add to chili mixture.
Transfer to glass jar; seal. Place in sun 24 hours, shaking occasionally.
Add lemon juice; seal and shake. Mature in sun 3-7 days until chilies lose color. Refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Makes 1 1/2 cups. Madhur's family recipe.

recipes.name: Cucumber Raita
instructions: Grate cucumber finely.
Whisk yogurt smooth. Add cucumber, mint, cumin, cayenne; season. Mix.
Refrigerate covered until ready to use.
recipes.notes: Cooling yogurt condiment. Pairs with biryani or kebabs.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
instructions: Combine cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, ginger, black pepper, tea bags, water in a pot. Boil over medium.
Cover; reduce to low. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add milk and sugar; simmer 1 minute.
Strain through fine-mesh strainer. Serve.
recipes.notes: Customize spices; double sugar for sweeter.

recipes.name: Dahi Puri Chaat

ingredients.name: plain yogurt or curd, plus 6 tbsp

instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, 10-15 minutes. Drain, cool, peel, roughly chop.
Whisk yogurt smooth.
Poke a hole through top of each puri. Add 3-4 pieces potato, then 4-5 chickpeas. Spoon tamarind chutney; top with yogurt.
Sprinkle each puri with cumin powder, chili powder, salt.
Drizzle with green chutney; sprinkle with sev. Serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Street food chaat. Best assembled a la minute.

recipes.name: Red Wine Poached Egg, Sautéed Asparagus, and Purée with King Trumpet Mushrooms
instructions: Make lemon salt: zest Meyer lemons into a mortar and pestle with Maldon salt. Crush together until fragrant.
Trim woody ends from asparagus. Cut thin slices off the trimmed ends and reserve for purée; cut remaining spears to about 5 inches.
Heat cast-iron pan over medium-high. Season asparagus with black pepper and lemon salt. Add olive oil; sauté spears 90 seconds. Flip, add butter, char another 90 seconds.
Deglaze with vegetable stock; cover with foil and steam 2 to 5 minutes until knife slides through. Reserve.

For purée: melt butter in shallow saucepan over medium-low. Add shallots, chopped garlic, and 1 tbsp olive oil; sauté 3 minutes without color. Add reserved asparagus slices, salt, pepper, and lemon thyme; cook 3-5 minutes until softened.
Deglaze with vegetable stock to submerge; bring to simmer, cover, rest 2½ minutes.
Return heat to medium, add cream, boil 1-2 minutes. Blend on increasing speed until silky. Pass into squeeze bottle.

For mushrooms: heat olive oil in skillet. Slice trumpet mushrooms in half lengthwise and score cut sides in a crosshatch. Sear cut-side down 3-5 minutes until golden. Flip, add crushed garlic and thyme; cook 2 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

For poached eggs: bring red wine, bay leaves, and crushed garlic to a rolling boil. Use a whisk to create a whirlpool, then drop one egg in. Poach 2 to 2½ minutes. Test by examining shape on slotted spoon. Repeat for remaining eggs.
To plate: lay 3-5 asparagus spears (both colors) in a V on the plate. Place mushrooms randomly. Squeeze dots of asparagus purée around the edge. Top with poached egg and finish with lemon salt.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: Gordon's Street Spritz. Asparagus stems can be saved for stock. Substitute regular thyme + lemon zest for lemon thyme if needed.

recipes.name: Crispy Five-Spice Duck with Black Cherry Glaze, Caramelized Red Endive, and Sautéed Spinach
instructions: Five-spice: toast each spice individually in a pan or 375°F oven 4-8 minutes until fragrant. Cool and grind in mortar and pestle; mix with salt.
Orange salt: zest oranges into mortar with Maldon salt and crush together.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Trim excess skin on duck. Score skin in a crosshatch pattern. Coat in salt and five-spice; rest 2 minutes.
Heat cast-iron pan on low 3 minutes. Lay duck skin-down, increase to medium. Add skin trimmings. Sear 3-5 minutes until skin is golden and fat rendered.
Add thyme and garlic; sauté 1 minute. Place aromatics on top of duck skin-side-down and roast 8-10 minutes to 135°F internal. Rest 8-10 minutes.

Endive: trim stems and halve lengthwise. Sprinkle with salt and powdered sugar, drizzle aged balsamic, finish with orange zest. Caramelize cut-side-down in olive oil 1-2 minutes. Flip, deglaze with orange juice, add remaining olive oil and zest. Braise 2-3 minutes.

Black cherry glaze: drain duck pan, add honey, caramelize 2 minutes. Deglaze with red wine vinegar. Once syrupy, add chicken stock and reduce 3-5 minutes. Add soy sauce, reduce. Add cherries; cook 1-2 minutes.
Spinach: heat olive oil over medium-high. Add salt, spinach, more salt and pepper. After 10 seconds add garlic and shallots; toss until just wilted (no more than 20 seconds total).
Plate: fan three endive across the top of the plate. Add a spoonful of spinach below. Slice duck and shingle over spinach. Spoon cherries around bottom; spoon glaze over. Finish with orange salt.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: Bird of Paradise (vodka, Chambord, Cointreau). Make 5-spice in bulk; keeps 6 months airtight. Substitute tamari for soy sauce for gluten-free.

recipes.name: Pomme Purée (Gordon Ramsay)

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and diced

instructions: Infused cream: bring heavy cream, bay, oil, garlic, and nutmeg to a boil; reduce by one fourth (3-5 min). Season with salt. Strain through a sieve, smashing garlic for flavor.
Submerge diced potatoes in cold water with 1 tbsp salt. Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer; cook 7-8 minutes until a potato smashes easily.
Drain potatoes and return to pot covered over medium heat 1-2 minutes to dry. Pass through a ricer.
Fold in a third of the infused cream, then a third more. Fold in cubed butter a knob at a time. Whip lightly, taste, adjust seasoning.
Fold in scallions. Spoon into serving bowls, sprinkle generously with chives and finish with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
recipes.notes: Can substitute Kennebec or other waxy potato. Try infusing cream with basil for serving with steak. Gluten-free and vegetarian.

recipes.name: Charred Cauliflower Steak with Olive Pistou and Porcini Mushrooms

ingredients.name: Castelvetrano green olives, pitted and quartered
Niçoise or Kalamata olives, pitted and quartered

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Trim cauliflower leaves and base. Wet a chef's knife and cut two 1-inch steaks from each head.
Drizzle sheet tray with 8 tbsp olive oil, sprinkle 2 tbsp harissa and salt. Rub one side of steaks in the mix; flip and dress the other side similarly. Finish with Maldon.

Heat two cast-iron skillets on medium-high with 1 tbsp olive oil in each. Sear steaks 90 seconds; flip, add 2 tbsp butter per pan, baste. Add vegetable stock to bubble. Roast 8-10 minutes until tender.
Olive pistou: mix quartered olives with extra virgin olive oil, orange juice and zest, lemon juice and zest, and parsley. Season.

Porcini: heat olive oil in sauté pan. Slice porcini lengthwise. Cook porcini 3-5 minutes, season. Add sliced shallots and garlic; cook 5 minutes until translucent. Zest lemon and stir in olive pistou.
Lower heat, add chiffonade mint and capers. Adjust seasoning.
Plate two steaks with cores facing each other. Spoon pistou and mushrooms over. Finish with extra virgin olive oil, lemon zest, juice, and chive/garlic blossoms.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: dirty martini. Gluten-free and vegetarian. Substitute olive oil for butter to make vegan. Harissa can vary in heat.

recipes.name: Basil Crusted Rack of Lamb with Glazed Thumbelina Carrots, New Potatoes, and Mint Yogurt Sauce

ingredients.name: New Zealand rack of lamb (14-16 oz each)

instructions: Basil crust: pulse basil, parsley, panko, salt, and Parmesan in a food processor until bright green and even.

Preheat oven 375°F. Season lamb racks with salt and pepper. Heat cast-iron pans on medium-high with grapeseed oil. Sear racks 60 seconds each side. Add thyme, garlic, butter; baste another minute. Roast 4-5 minutes to 125°F. Rest.
Brush flesh side with Dijon, rest 2 minutes, repeat. Dip into basil crust to coat.
Blanch carrots 2 minutes in salted boiling water; shock in ice bath. Repeat with turnips. Dry on paper towels.

Heat olive oil in large sauté pan over medium. Add cinnamon sticks, star anise, honey, and salt. Once honey bubbles, add blanched vegetables; toss 3 minutes. Add butter; let froth, then deglaze with chicken stock. Cook 2-3 minutes until glazed.
Boil new potatoes in salted water 10 minutes; drain and cool. Halve; sauté cut-side-down in olive oil 3-5 minutes until brown. Flip, add butter, cook 3 minutes more.
Mint yogurt: chiffonade then rough chop mint. Mix with yogurt, lemon zest, salt, and a squeeze of lemon juice.

Plate: spoon yogurt at 6 o'clock spread to 8. Lay carrots and turnips alternating; garnish with star anise and cinnamon stick. Fan potatoes. Slice rack into chops; shingle over plate. Finish with Maldon.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: young Bordeaux-style red. Substitute fingerlings or small Yukons for new potatoes; baby carrots for Thumbelina; diced turnips for Tokyo. Gluten-free with GF panko.

recipes.name: Roasted Turkish Spiced Eggplant with Basil and Feta

ingredients.name: 28 oz cans crushed San Marzano tomatoes

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Drain canned tomatoes in a sieve over a bowl 30 minutes.

Halve eggplants lengthwise. Score cut sides in crosshatch. Salt heavily; rest cut-side-down on rack 10 minutes; pat dry. Insert garlic halves into score marks. Drizzle each half with olive oil; season with pepper.
Heat two cast-iron pans medium-high with 1 tbsp olive oil each. Sear eggplants cut-side-down 3-5 minutes until dark golden brown. Roast 20-30 minutes until tender. Cool to handle.
Scoop eggplant flesh from skins. Mince eggplant and roasted garlic into a paste.
Add 2 tbsp olive oil to a large nonstick pan over medium. Sweat onions 2-3 minutes. Season generously with salt and 1 tbsp cracked pepper. Add cumin, coriander, cardamom; cook 2 minutes.
Add eggplant; stir with wooden spoon, lower to medium-low, cook 3-4 minutes. Add grated ginger; cook 2 minutes. Add drained tomatoes; cook 5-10 minutes until reduced.
Chiffonade basil; stir in and cook 1 more minute.
Transfer to serving bowls. Top with feta, drizzle of olive oil, and micro sorrel.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: light red wine like pinot noir. Gluten-free; can be vegan without feta. Substitute regular canned tomatoes if no San Marzano.

recipes.name: Grilled Baby Leeks, Warm Miso Broth, and Citrus Caviar Vinaigrette
instructions: Trim leeks; leave stalks intact. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat grill pan over medium-high. Grill leeks perpendicular to grill lines with weight (plates) for 30 seconds; cook 2 more minutes for marks. Flip and repeat.
Drizzle grilled leeks with olive oil and zest of lemon over the top.
Miso broth: bring vegetable stock to a boil; whisk in white miso. Reduce until it thinly coats a spoon. Add leeks and poach covered on low 8-10 minutes.
Remove leeks; reduce broth for a few more minutes until twice as thick as poaching liquid.
Vinaigrette: combine 4 tbsp reduced miso broth, salt, pepper. Whisk in olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest. Stir in chives, grated egg whites and yolks, fold in caviar.
Plate: fan leeks on a platter. Brush with miso broth. Layer more leeks and brush again. Spoon vinaigrette on both sides; top with micro mustard greens.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: Gordon's gin and tonic. Use sweet (white/yellow) miso; dark miso would overpower. Substitute spring onions or thick scallions for baby leeks. Push hard-boiled egg whites/yolks separately through a sieve.

recipes.name: Szechuan Pepper Roasted Whole Chicken Stuffed with Lemon, Fennel, Onion, and Thai Basil
instructions: Szechuan pepper mix: crush black and Szechuan peppercorns; combine.
Lemon salt: zest Meyer lemons into mortar; crush with Maldon salt until fragrant.
Preheat oven 400°F. Bring chicken to room temp. Stand neck-down; season cavity with 1-2 tbsp lemon salt. Stuff with onion, lemon, fennel wedges, then Thai basil center.
Whisk egg yolks; brush over all visible skin (not back). Sprinkle 3 tbsp Szechuan pepper mix and 4 tbsp lemon salt evenly over the chicken.
Truss with butcher's twine: wrap lengthwise, cross at the ankles, bring legs close. Tie off in a bow.
Place on a wire rack on a sheet tray; roast center rack 60 minutes to 165°F in leg joint. Rest 10 minutes; remove twine.
Drain juices through a sieve into a bowl and reserve (used for Szechuan Chicken Breast / Udon).
Carve: remove legs at joint by dislocating; separate breast with knife following sternum; remove breast/wing in one piece. Separate thigh from drumstick. Reserve carcass for stock.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing not listed. Pepper mix keeps 3 years airtight. Szechuan pepper isn't spicy — numbing with lemony notes. Reserved chicken juices and breasts are used in the udon noodle recipe.

recipes.name: Hoisin Glazed Crispy Shredded Chicken Salad with Pickled Daikon and Honey Mustard Vinaigrette

ingredients.name: roasted chicken thighs and legs, shredded (skins julienned)

instructions: Shred chicken meat into ¼-inch pieces. Mix cornstarch and rice flour; sift over chicken and toss.
Heat 1 inch vegetable oil in a wok to 350°F. Shake dredged chicken on a spider; fry small batches 2-4 minutes until golden. Drain. Fry julienned skin without dredge for about 2 minutes.
Mix hoisin and rice wine vinegar; toss with crispy chicken. Finish with lemon zest and chives.
Pickled daikon and ginger: heat 1 cup each water, sugar, and rice wine vinegar to a boil. Pour hot pickle over julienned daikon and ginger in separate bowls; soak 20 minutes then refrigerate.
Vinaigrette: whisk honey, Dijon, lemon juice; whisk in olive oil.
Lettuce flower: lay lettuce core-down, pry layers open. Drizzle with vinaigrette. Spoon chicken into the leaves. Garnish with pickled daikon, ginger, scallions, and more vinaigrette.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: New Zealand Pinot Gris. Use tamari for gluten-free. Substitute scallions for chives. Substitute green leaf/romaine/iceberg for bibb (presented as cups).

recipes.name: Szechuan Crusted Chicken Breast with Udon Noodles, Bok Choy, and Ramen Broth

ingredients.name: sugar snap peas, sliced on bias
roasted Szechuan crusted chicken breasts (from Ch 9)
scallions, thinly sliced on the bias (garnish)

instructions: Lemon salt: zest Meyer lemons with Maldon and crush in mortar.
Heat 2 tsp olive oil in large sauté pan medium-high. Sauté shiitake 3 minutes with sesame oil. Add bok choy and butter, sauté 1 minute. Add snap peas and scallions; toss and cook 2 minutes. Reserve.
Boil 2 qts salted water; cook udon 8 minutes to al dente. Strain, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil. Combine with vegetables.

Ramen broth: simmer chicken stock with reserved chicken juices, lemongrass, ginger, cilantro, and garlic over medium 5 minutes. Add soy sauce and rice wine vinegar; reduce 20 minutes by half. Strain. Add picked cilantro leaves and 2 tsp sesame oil.

Plate: thread half noodles on a meat fork, twist into a nest in a 10-12 inch bowl. Repeat. Top with half the vegetables. Slice chicken breast into 4 pieces; lay over noodles. Ladle broth around to half-inch from top of noodles. Finish with scallions and lemon salt.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: IPA. Use tamari and GF noodles for gluten-free. Re-warm reserved breasts skin-up in stock under foil at 350°F until 165°F.

recipes.name: Sesame Seed Crusted Tuna Loin with Pickled Cucumber Salad and Yuzu-Sesame Dressing

ingredients.name: micro chives, arugula, celery, radish, ruby sorrel

instructions: Mix white and black sesame seeds. Season tuna with salt and pepper. Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks; brush onto tuna. Zest lime over tuna. Roll tuna in sesame seeds to coat; press evenly.
Heat grapeseed oil in nonstick pan over medium 3 minutes — not smoking. Sear one tuna at a time, tilting pan to create an oil reservoir and cooking each side until seeds toast but tuna stays rare.

Pickled cucumber: spiralize cucumbers (skin on); salt lightly. Heat water, sugar, vinegar, and coriander seeds until sugar dissolves; cool. Pour ¾ pickling liquid plus cilantro over cucumbers; marinate 5+ minutes. Marinate radish slices in remaining liquid 1-2 minutes before plating.
Dressing: whisk yuzu, lime juice, and lime zest. Slowly whisk in sesame oil and olive oil. Season and stir in cilantro.

Plate: drain marinated cucumbers; nest into center of plate using meat fork. Slice tuna into 5 pieces each; shingle over cucumber. Spoon dressing around and over. Scatter pickled radish. Top with microgreens.
recipes.notes: Beverage pairing: Botanical Sling Cocktail. Source sushi-grade tuna from a fishmonger; never freeze. Substitute lime+lemon (2:1) for yuzu.

recipes.name: Raspberry Coulis (Gordon Ramsay)
instructions: Combine raspberries, sugar, and water in a medium saucepan. Cover and steam 5-8 minutes until berries break down.
Uncover and reduce 5 minutes until syrupy. Do not let liquid brown.
Blend on low, increasing to high, 1 minute until jam-like.
Pass through a sieve into a bowl. Reserve 100 g for soufflé base; keep remaining warm or room temp for plating.
recipes.notes: Sub frozen raspberry purée (Boiron brand) if short on time. Coulis is French for a strained fruit/vegetable purée used as a sauce.
